why_v4_was_067526_and_how_v5_surpasses_v.issue_1_in_v4: In V4, test.csv's Target Encodings inside each 5-fold loop were computed using only tr_idx (80% of train.csv = 12,000 rows), throwing away 3,000 training labels in every fold, whereas V1 used 100% of train.csv (15,000 rows) for test.csv Target Encodings.
why_v4_was_067526_and_how_v5_surpasses_v.issue_2_in_v4: In V4, GBDTs were given 153 base columns (including 41 sparse One-Hot columns that diluted feature subsampling) and only 40% ensemble weight (vs V1's 60% GBDT weight on 64 compact columns).
why_v4_was_067526_and_how_v5_surpasses_v.issue_3_in_v4: In V4, Target Encodings were passed only in raw 1:2:4 probability scale without Balanced 1:1:1 Prior Calibration (te_bal_p) and Log-Odds expansion (te_log_p).
v5_upgrades: 1. Full-100%-Train Test TE (using all 15,000 training rows for test.csv target encodings while training models on strictly leak-free Double-Nested OOF TE).
2. Compact 73-column high-signal feature routing for GBDTs + Multi-Depth (Depth 4, 5, 6) + Symmetric Ordinal Specialist GBDTs (boosting Zero-Leakage GBDT Family OOF from 0.67547 to 0.68088!).
3. Balanced 1:1:1 Prior Target Encodings + Log-Odds + Pure-Physical Within-Village Kernel KNN.
4. Restored 62% GBDT + 38% Spline/MLP ratio using 50% Linear + 50% Log-Linear (Geometric Mean) Hybrid Pooling across 13 diverse models.
